title: Costco's Real Product Is Its Membership Card
summary: Costco sold $297 billion of goods last year and kept less than two cents on the dollar from those sales. Its membership fees are only about 2% of revenue, yet about half of its operating profit. Where $100 at the checkout goes, why the shelves barely break even, and what 84 million members are really paying for. Every number is sourced below.
